# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Practice Success

Ensora Health builds EHR and practice management software for mental, behavioral, and rehabilitative
therapy – designed to help your practice and clients thrive.
[Request a demo][135]

## TheraNest

### Mental Health

TheraNest is a mental health EHR and practice management solution built to help you save time,
reduce admin, and run a successful practice.
[Start a free trial][136]

## Fusion

### Rehab Therapy

Fusion’s EHR simplifies documentation, scheduling, and billing – so physical, occupational, and
speech therapy teams can work through the day with ease.
[Request a demo][137]

## Lightening the load for every part of your practice

Whether you’re a solo therapist, part of a large group, or a member of the admin support staff,
we’re here to help you deliver exceptional care.

Mental health solo practices
When you’re a solo therapist, you carry the full weight of your practice. You need fewer systems to
manage, fewer fires to chase, and more space for meaningful moments. TheraNest helps you stay
organized and sustainable without extra effort.
[[Resources] Learn More][138]
Mental health group practices
Group practices juggle shifting schedules, tight cash flow, and costly no-shows. Supporting
clinicians and clients is key, but admin tasks feel overwhelming. You deserve a simpler path
forward.
[[Resources] Learn More][139]
Rehab therapy
Documentation, authorizations, and shifting schedules can push admin work late into the night. Built
by therapists who understand, Fusion streamlines your workflow in one EHR — so your PT/ OT/ SLP team
can avoid burnout and focus on clients.
[[Resources] Learn More][140]

## Practice success with Ensora Health

We build and fine-tune our solutions with input from clinicians, their clients, and practice owners
and administrators. That’s why they are designed to solve real problems, not just check boxes.

Automate and simplify admin work with an all-in-one mental health EHR and PMS.

## About Us

Shweta Patil, an ENT doctor in Pimpri Chinchwad, in Pune, has well equipped ENT Clinic at
Dhanwantari Hospital, Nigdi and Dhanwantari's Chrysalis, Ravet, having all the facilities and
technology for diagnosis to surgery to treat your Ear, Nose & Throat problems effectively.

Our ears, nose & throat are connected with each other and work together as an intimate trio. That is
the reason a problem in any one of these lead to affect ears, nose & throat altogether, for e.g.
discomfort in the nose may affect the throat. For any discomfort or problem related to these areas
like an ear infection or hearing loss, nasal allergies, sinusitis or congestion o r chronic sore
throat or strep, one should consult ENT doctors for total cure and effective treatment.

[read more][23]

## Our Featured Services

[
EAR

There are different types of ear infections. Middle ear infection (acute otitis media) is an
infection in the middle ear. Hearing and balance are critical to how we conduct our daily lives. We
treat conditions such as ear infection, hearing loss, dizziness, ringing in the ears (called
tinnitus), ear, face, or neck pain, and more.

][24]
[
NOSE

Our noses facilitate breathing by helping to keep out potentially harmful dirt, allergens, and other
agents. In addition to allergies, we treat deviated septum, rhinitis, sinusitis, sinus headaches and
migraines, nasal obstruction and surgery, skull-base tumors including those inside the cranial
cavity, and more.

][25]
[
THROAT

Disorders that affect our ability to speak and swallow properly can have a tremendous impact on our
lives and livelihoods. We treat the sore throat, hoarseness, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD),
infections, throat tumors, airway and vocal cord disorders, and many more.


][26]
[
Vertigo Treatment

Vertigo is the illusion of movement. It is a sensation that is only experienced by the patient,
making it difficult to describe or evaluate a person in two ways:
1. It may feel as like if the environment around you is whirling or spinning.



][27]

## FAQ

Here are answers to some common questions.

### What is Neurotology and how does it differ from Otology? ▶

Neurotology focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of inner ear disorders and their connection to
the brain and nervous system, whereas Otology deals with the broader spectrum of ear-related issues,
including middle and outer ear problems.

### What conditions does Rhinology treat? ▶

Rhinology specializes in treating disorders of the nose and sinuses, such as sinus infections, nasal
polyps, deviated septum, allergies, and chronic rhinitis.

### What are common symptoms that require a visit to a Laryngologist? ▶

You should consult a Laryngologist for issues like persistent hoarseness, vocal cord problems,
throat pain, swallowing difficulties, and chronic cough.

### What are the causes of vertigo, and how is it treated? ▶

Vertigo is commonly caused by inner ear disorders such as BPPV (Benign Paroxysmal Positional
Vertigo), Meniere's disease, or vestibular neuritis. Treatment may include repositioning maneuvers,
medication, or vestibular rehabilitation therapy.

### What procedures are available for hearing loss due to inner ear damage? ▶

Treatments for inner ear hearing loss include hearing aids, cochlear implants, or surgical options
depending on the severity and cause of the condition.

### What advanced treatments are available for sinus issues in Rhinology? ▶

Advanced treatments include endoscopic sinus surgery, balloon sinuplasty, and image-guided surgery
to ensure precision in clearing blockages and improving airflow.

## FAQ

Here are answers to some common questions.

### What is Neurotology and how does it differ from Otology? ▶

Neurotology focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of inner ear disorders and their connection to
the brain and nervous system, whereas Otology deals with the broader spectrum of ear-related issues,
including middle and outer ear problems.

### What conditions does Rhinology treat? ▶

Rhinology specializes in treating disorders of the nose and sinuses, such as sinus infections, nasal
polyps, deviated septum, allergies, and chronic rhinitis.

### What are common symptoms that require a visit to a Laryngologist? ▶

You should consult a Laryngologist for issues like persistent hoarseness, vocal cord problems,
throat pain, swallowing difficulties, and chronic cough.

### What are the causes of vertigo, and how is it treated? ▶

Vertigo is commonly caused by inner ear disorders such as BPPV (Benign Paroxysmal Positional
Vertigo), Meniere's disease, or vestibular neuritis. Treatment may include repositioning maneuvers,
medication, or vestibular rehabilitation therapy.

### What procedures are available for hearing loss due to inner ear damage? ▶

Treatments for inner ear hearing loss include hearing aids, cochlear implants, or surgical options
depending on the severity and cause of the condition.

### What advanced treatments are available for sinus issues in Rhinology? ▶

Advanced treatments include endoscopic sinus surgery, balloon sinuplasty, and image-guided surgery
to ensure precision in clearing blockages and improving airflow.

# Ent Health

## **Be ENT Healthy!**

[Dysphagia][35] means that you cannot swallow well. If you have concerns about your ability to
swallow, [take this 10-question quiz][36]. Summer is also when many families want to get outside and
enjoy the warm weather but make sure to [protect your loved ones against skin cancer][37]. And find
out what you should know about [congenital cytomegalovirus (cCMV)][38].

[**Visit Be ENT Smart for more health tips.**][39]

## Be ENT Healthy!

[Dysphagia][40] means that you cannot swallow well. If you have concerns about your ability to
swallow, [take this 10-question quiz][41]. Summer is also when many families want to get outside and
enjoy the warm weather but make sure to [protect your loved ones against skin cancer][42]. And find
out what you should know about [congenital cytomegalovirus (cCMV)][43].

[ Visit Be ENT Smart for more health tips. ][44]

## Spotlight

### [NEW! ENT Patient Stories][45]

ENT patients span the gamut of life. ENT specialists are trained to treat and manage life’s
fundamental functions and disorders. [Read these stories][46] from real-life patients.
[ [Doctor fitting patient with hearing aid] ][47]

### [OTC Hearing Aids FAQs][48]

Over-the-counter (OTC) hearing aids are now available to adults 18 years of age or older with
mild-to-moderate hearing loss. [Read these important FAQs.][49]

### [Improve Your Sleep Quality][50]

Making some simple but important changes to your sleep hygiene can help improve the overall quality
and duration of your sleep. [Watch this video][51] and consider these tips.

### Discover ENThealth!

Scroll through “Conditions and Treatments” to learn about specific ENT conditions. Explore consumer
articles and health tips in the “Be ENT Smart” area. Or, use the magnifying glass search function
located under the “Find an ENT” button to type in a specific term.

[Learn More about the ENT Specialty][52]

## Symptom Checker

***COMING SOON!*** Enter symptoms to find information on possible ENT-related conditions

## Get the Care You Need

### Find an ENT

Think you need to consult an ENT specialist? Find someone with the expertise and location that’s
best for your needs.

[Find a Doctor Near You][54]

### Be ENT Smart

Learn how to stay ENT healthy, prevent problems, and manage existing conditions to improve your, or
a loved one’s, daily life.

[Live Your Best ENT Life][55]

### About ENThealth.org

Find out more about the community of physician experts who can help you to Be ENT Smart and how the
information was developed.

## FAQ’s About Physiotherapy Services In Burnaby

### Do I Need a Referral To See a Physiotherapist in BC?

No, you don’t need a referral to see a physiotherapist in British Columbia. You can contact any
registered physiotherapist directly and book an appointment. However, it is important to note that
in some cases, your medical doctor or specialist may want to refer you for physiotherapy services.

### What Are the 3 Types of Physiotherapy?

Physiotherapy is an evidence-based medical practice that focuses on restoring and maintaining
optimal physical functioning. It is used to treat a variety of conditions, from sports injuries to
chronic pain, and can be divided into three main categories: manual therapy, exercise therapy, and
electrotherapy.

**Manual Therapy** involves the use of hands-on techniques such as massage, joint mobilization, and
soft tissue manipulation to decrease pain and inflammation, improve range of motion and mobility,
restore muscle balance, reduce spasms and stiffness, improve posture, increase flexibility, and
promote healing.

**Exercise Therapy** is used to correct muscular imbalances or weaknesses that can lead to injury or
chronic pain. Therapeutic exercises are prescribed specifically for each patient to strengthen weak
muscles and improve flexibility, coordination, balance, and posture.

**Electrotherapy** is the use of electrical stimulation to treat various musculoskeletal conditions.
Techniques such as ultrasound, TENS (transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation), and Shockwave are
used to reduce pain, inflammation, swelling, muscle spasm, and stiffness.

### What Common Health Conditions Can Expert Physio Help With?
* Chronic conditions
* Workplace injuries
* Rotator cuff issues
* Musculoskeletal injuries
* Low back pain
* Loss of balance
* Shoulder injury recovery/return
* Spinal injury prevention
* Neck pain
* Chronic pain
* Joint pain relief
* Muscle tightness
* Motor vehicle injuries

## FAQ’s About Physiotherapy Services In Burnaby

### Do I Need a Referral To See a Physiotherapist in BC?

No, you don’t need a referral to see a physiotherapist in British Columbia. You can contact any
registered physiotherapist directly and book an appointment. However, it is important to note that
in some cases, your medical doctor or specialist may want to refer you for physiotherapy services.

### What Are the 3 Types of Physiotherapy?

Physiotherapy is an evidence-based medical practice that focuses on restoring and maintaining
optimal physical functioning. It is used to treat a variety of conditions, from sports injuries to
chronic pain, and can be divided into three main categories: manual therapy, exercise therapy, and
electrotherapy.

**Manual Therapy** involves the use of hands-on techniques such as massage, joint mobilization, and
soft tissue manipulation to decrease pain and inflammation, improve range of motion and mobility,
restore muscle balance, reduce spasms and stiffness, improve posture, increase flexibility, and
promote healing.

**Exercise Therapy** is used to correct muscular imbalances or weaknesses that can lead to injury or
chronic pain. Therapeutic exercises are prescribed specifically for each patient to strengthen weak
muscles and improve flexibility, coordination, balance, and posture.

**Electrotherapy** is the use of electrical stimulation to treat various musculoskeletal conditions.
Techniques such as ultrasound, TENS (transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation), and Shockwave are
used to reduce pain, inflammation, swelling, muscle spasm, and stiffness.

## Special Klimawandel und Gesundheit

Der Klimawandel verändert auch das Wetter in Deutschland. Steigende Temperaturen können den Körper
dabei in vielerlei Hinsicht belasten. Aber nicht nur die Hitze selbst kann negative Auswirkungen auf
die Gesundheit haben.

[ Mehr erfahren][92]

## Zugriffsrechte und Datenspeicherung Meine Möglichkeiten in der ePA

Die Inhalte Ihrer elektronischen Patientenakte (ePA) können Sie selbst verwalten: Sie bestimmen,
welche Inhalte in Ihrer ePA gespeichert werden. Außerdem können Sie entscheiden, wer Zugriff auf
Ihre ePA hat.

[Wie verwalte ich meine ePA?][93]

## Special Digitale Versorgung

Elektronische Rezepte (E-Rezepte) und Patientenakte (ePA) sind praktisch und bequem. Sie fördern die
digitale Vernetzung im Gesundheitswesen und sollen Vorgänge vereinfachen.

[ Mehr erfahren][94]

## Gesundheit digital Gesundheit und Digitalisierung

Die Digitalisierung bringt viele Chancen mit sich – auch für die Gesundheit. Dank digitaler
Vernetzung stehen Informationen zur Gesundheit schneller und einfacher zur Verfügung. Zudem können
Gesundheits-Apps die Behandlung von Krankheiten unterstützen und verbessern.
 

[ Mehr erfahren][95]

## Gut informiert Ausgewählte Themen

### Leistungen für Versicherte

Im Krankheitsfall übernimmt die gesetzliche Krankenkasse die Kosten der medizinisch notwendigen
Behandlung. Mehr zu den Leistungen und Zuzahlungen lesen sie hier.

Mehr erfahren

### Pflegende Angehörige

Die Pflege von Mitmenschen ist eine wichtige Aufgabe, die sehr fordernd sein kann. Pflegende
Angehörige finden hier Informationen zu Unterstützung, sozialer Absicherung und weiteren
Hilfestellungen.

Mehr erfahren

### Schwangerschaft und Geburt

Die Zeit der Schwangerschaft ist auch eine Zeit vieler Fragen und eine intensive Lebenserfahrung.
Welche Beratungen und Untersuchungen Schwangere in Anspruch nehmen können, erfahren Sie hier.

Mehr erfahren

### Psyche und Wohlbefinden

Sport oder Meditation? Es gibt verschiedene Maßnahmen Stress und Belastungen des Alltags zu
bewältigen, das eigene Wohbefinden zu steigern oder zur Ruhe zu kommen.

Mehr erfahren

### Muskeln, Knochen und Gelenke

Viele Erkrankungen des Bewegungsapparates sind auf altersbedingten Verschleiß zurückzuführen –
zunehmend auch auf zu wenig Bewegung und zu viel Sitzen.

Mehr erfahren

### Blut- und Lymphsystem

Das Blut- und Lymphsystem durchdringt den menschlichen Körper und steht im engen Austausch
miteinander. Beide Systeme spielen bei der Abwehr von Krankheitserregern eine zentrale Rolle.

Mehr erfahren

## Special Klimawandel und Gesundheit

Der Klimawandel verändert auch das Wetter in Deutschland. Steigende Temperaturen können den Körper
dabei in vielerlei Hinsicht belasten. Aber nicht nur die Hitze selbst kann negative Auswirkungen auf
die Gesundheit haben.

[ Mehr erfahren][92]

## Zugriffsrechte und Datenspeicherung Meine Möglichkeiten in der ePA

Die Inhalte Ihrer elektronischen Patientenakte (ePA) können Sie selbst verwalten: Sie bestimmen,
welche Inhalte in Ihrer ePA gespeichert werden. Außerdem können Sie entscheiden, wer Zugriff auf
Ihre ePA hat.

[Wie verwalte ich meine ePA?][93]

## Special Digitale Versorgung

Elektronische Rezepte (E-Rezepte) und Patientenakte (ePA) sind praktisch und bequem. Sie fördern die
digitale Vernetzung im Gesundheitswesen und sollen Vorgänge vereinfachen.

[ Mehr erfahren][94]

## Gesundheit digital Gesundheit und Digitalisierung

Die Digitalisierung bringt viele Chancen mit sich – auch für die Gesundheit. Dank digitaler
Vernetzung stehen Informationen zur Gesundheit schneller und einfacher zur Verfügung. Zudem können
Gesundheits-Apps die Behandlung von Krankheiten unterstützen und verbessern.
 

[ Mehr erfahren][95]

## Special Gesundheitsdaten: Nutzung und Datenschutz

Gesundheitsdaten werden ständig erhoben: beim Hausarzt, im Krankenhaus, aber auch vom Fitnesstracker
am Handgelenk. Sie sind nicht nur wichtig für die Versorgung von Patientinnen und Patienten, sondern
auch wertvoll für die medizinische Forschung.

[ Mehr erfahren][96]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

# THE Integrative Medicine CENTER

## Leading-edge Integrative Functional Medicine

The Integrative Medicine Center is a place where you can get a leading-edge integrative functional
medicine consultation along with expert guidance on natural supplements – where you can experience
the latest in cosmetic skin care backed by advanced anti-aging medicine – where your healthcare
involves experts in many fields working together for you – a place where you are at the center of
your healthcare journey.

## “state of the art” treatments and diagnostics

Bringing together the best of conventional medicine along with complementary and alternative medical
therapies, our providers use “state of the art” treatments and diagnostics combined with the
“ancient healing arts” such as traditional Chinese medicine and acupuncture.

Restoring wellness and vitality both inside and out, we treat the whole person – body, mind and
spirit.

# **Lighting the way to a healthier you.**

**Seeking personalized physical therapy in Pennsylvania?**

LHM Physical Therapy Institute is your full-service outpatient provider, committed to enhancing your
quality of life. We deliver exceptional care for a wide range of needs, including orthopedic and
sports rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, neurological therapy, fall prevention, pediatric
physical therapy and more.

[Find a Clinic Near You][25]

## Now Welcoming New Patients

Ready to get started? We’ll work to schedule your first appointment within 24 hours, so you don’t
have to wait to begin your healing journey. Plus, to make your experience as smooth as possible, we
work with most major insurance providers. Let us help you verify your benefits.

[Request Appointment][26]

## Maintain Your Wellness

When you graduate physical therapy, continue your transition to independent fitness with the
[Wellness Pathway][27]. Offering more than your typical gym membership, this program offers
proactive and personalized support from our experienced team.

## Health & Performance Services

Take charge of your wellbeing before challenges arise with prevention-focused and performance-driven
solutions. Whether you’re looking to elevate your performance or add recovery methods to support
training, our [Health & Performance Services][28] are available without a physician’s prescription.

[Complimentary Consultation][29]

## Therapy Services

[ Orthopedic Rehabilitation][30]
[ Sports Rehabilitation][31]
[ Pre & Post Operative Rehabilitation][32]
[ Vestibular Rehabilitation][33]
[ Neurological Rehabilitation][34]
[ Pediatric Rehabilitation][35]

# **Lighting the way to a healthier you.**

**Seeking personalized physical therapy in Pennsylvania?**

LHM Physical Therapy Institute is your full-service outpatient provider, committed to enhancing your
quality of life. We deliver exceptional care for a wide range of needs, including orthopedic and
sports rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, neurological therapy, fall prevention, pediatric
physical therapy and more.

[Find a Clinic Near You][25]

## Now Welcoming New Patients

Ready to get started? We’ll work to schedule your first appointment within 24 hours, so you don’t
have to wait to begin your healing journey. Plus, to make your experience as smooth as possible, we
work with most major insurance providers. Let us help you verify your benefits.

[Request Appointment][26]

## Maintain Your Wellness

When you graduate physical therapy, continue your transition to independent fitness with the
[Wellness Pathway][27]. Offering more than your typical gym membership, this program offers
proactive and personalized support from our experienced team.

## Health & Performance Services

Take charge of your wellbeing before challenges arise with prevention-focused and performance-driven
solutions. Whether you’re looking to elevate your performance or add recovery methods to support
training, our [Health & Performance Services][28] are available without a physician’s prescription.

[Complimentary Consultation][29]

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

# Welcome To NeuroBloom's

## In Pursuit of Better Health Solutions.

At NeuroBloom Physical Therapy & Wellness, we have the healing expertise in providing physical
rehabilitation therapy services. Our focus is to improve outcomes in the most holistic of manners
with the implementation of precise and cutting-edge evidence-based techniques along with compassion,
motivation, and hope to help clients reach their highest level of recovery to be able to return to
their prior level of function with improved patient outcomes.

[ About Us ][53]
[slide1]
[slide2]

With Rehabilitation therapy one can restore pre-illness or accident function and mobility and can
move more effortlessly and with less pain. Strengthens your muscles so you are less at risk of falls
or accidents, Improves your coordination for better mobility and easier movement.Physical therapy is
beneficial to people of all ages who are suffering from medical conditions, illnesses, or injuries
that are interfering with their ability to move and function normally.

A personalized rehabilitation therapy programme can assist individuals in returning to their
previous level of functioning while also encouraging activities and lifestyle changes that can help
prevent further injury and improve overall health and well-being.Due to the fact that physical
therapy is considered a conservative approach to treating problems, primary care doctors frequently
refer patients to physical therapy at the first sign of a problem.

###### COVID-19 safety measures

## NEUROBLOOM REHABILITATION

Our NeuroBloom team is fully vaccinated against COVID-19 and continues to provide highly skilled
care to our patients by following mask mandate protocol as well as other state and county
guidelines.

###### About Us

### Higher Standards Of Care Everytime.

Dr. Nidhi Seth is a neurologic physical therapist who specializes in the evaluation and treatment of
individuals with movement problems due to disease or injury of the nervous system.

Blending science with inspiration, I will teach you how to prevent or manage a health condition and
help motivate you during your treatment so you can function optimally. My goal is to work with you
to help you understand your body so you will achieve long-term health benefits.

# Welcome To NeuroBloom's

## In Pursuit of Better Health Solutions.

At NeuroBloom Physical Therapy & Wellness, we have the healing expertise in providing physical
rehabilitation therapy services. Our focus is to improve outcomes in the most holistic of manners
with the implementation of precise and cutting-edge evidence-based techniques along with compassion,
motivation, and hope to help clients reach their highest level of recovery to be able to return to
their prior level of function with improved patient outcomes.

[ About Us ][53]
[slide1]
[slide2]

With Rehabilitation therapy one can restore pre-illness or accident function and mobility and can
move more effortlessly and with less pain. Strengthens your muscles so you are less at risk of falls
or accidents, Improves your coordination for better mobility and easier movement.Physical therapy is
beneficial to people of all ages who are suffering from medical conditions, illnesses, or injuries
that are interfering with their ability to move and function normally.

A personalized rehabilitation therapy programme can assist individuals in returning to their
previous level of functioning while also encouraging activities and lifestyle changes that can help
prevent further injury and improve overall health and well-being.Due to the fact that physical
therapy is considered a conservative approach to treating problems, primary care doctors frequently
refer patients to physical therapy at the first sign of a problem.

###### COVID-19 safety measures

## NEUROBLOOM REHABILITATION

Our NeuroBloom team is fully vaccinated against COVID-19 and continues to provide highly skilled
care to our patients by following mask mandate protocol as well as other state and county
guidelines.

###### About Us

### Higher Standards Of Care Everytime.

Dr. Nidhi Seth is a neurologic physical therapist who specializes in the evaluation and treatment of
individuals with movement problems due to disease or injury of the nervous system.

Blending science with inspiration, I will teach you how to prevent or manage a health condition and
help motivate you during your treatment so you can function optimally. My goal is to work with you
to help you understand your body so you will achieve long-term health benefits.

## Early morning, daytime, evening and weekend physiotherapy & sports injury appointments

If you need to see one of us for physiotherapy or sports injury treatment, we stay open late during
the week and we offer weekend appointments at our Cambridge clinic, so we’ll be able to see you
quickly and at a time that suits you.

We have exceptional facilities, including a [ strength and conditioning gym ][82] and private
[pilates studio][83]. We offer a range of specialist services and the very latest medical techniques
including [ shockwave therapy ][84] and Hyaluron injections.

All our chartered physiotherapists are also trained to teach clinical Pilates and we offer online
pilates classes which might be recommended as part of your rehab programme.

# Your Musculoskeletal Health Matters

Welcome to Primacare Physical Therapy, where your journey to recovery and optimal wellness begins.
Our team of licensed Physical Therapists and Occupational Therapists are dedicated to providing
personalized, evidence-based care in a warm and supportive environment. Whether you're healing from
an injury, managing a chronic condition, or striving to enhance your mobility and strength, we’re
here to help you move better, feel better, and live better. Explore our services and discover how we
can support your health and well-being every step of the way.

[Explore Our Services ][47]

# Services

# [Foot and Ankle Rehabilitation][48]

No matter if you’ve sprained it, strained it, or had surgery, we help your feet and ankles get back
in step. Through strength, balance, and mobility work, we’ll have you walking, running, or dancing
again—without the ouch!

[Book Now ][49]

# [Physical 
# Rehabilitation][50]

# Therapy][52]

Introducing Shockwave Therapy in Suwanee and Johns Creek

An advanced, non-invasive treatment that reduces pain, stimulates healing, and treats conditions
like plantar fasciitis, tendinitis, and tennis elbow.
No surgery, no injections, and minimal downtime so you can get back to what you love faster.!

Call today Suwanee Clinic at [770-962-4043][44] for 50% discount on the first 10 patients

[Click to listen to NPR on Shockwave Therapy][45]


Schroth Therapy In Johns Creek

Schroth Therapy is a specialized, non-surgical treatment for scoliosis that uses customized
exercises and breathing techniques to improve spinal alignment and posture. At our Johns Creek, GA
clinic, each program is tailored to your specific curve pattern and goals. This evidence-based
approach helps reduce pain, enhance posture, and support long-term spinal stability.

Call [770-814-2986][46] to schedule an appointment

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Remaker AI?

+

Remaker AI is an AI-powered creative platform with AI image editing as its core feature. It provides
powerful image processing tools that allow users to easily perform photo restoration, background
removal, style transfer, image upscaling, and more. Additionally, Remaker AI includes AI video
generation and a rich library of trending entertainment templates, helping users quickly create
viral short videos, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. Whether for individual creators or
enterprise teams, Remaker AI significantly boosts creative efficiency and delivers
professional-grade results.

### How does Remaker AI help improve content creation efficiency?

+

Remaker AI offers a full suite of intelligent tools that can automatically generate and process
images or videos based on simple user inputs. This dramatically saves time while significantly
improving content quality, making it suitable for all industries and creative scenarios.

### Do I need technical knowledge to use Remaker AI?

+

No technical knowledge is required. Remaker AI features a clean and intuitive interface that anyone
can pick up instantly. Every tool page also includes detailed step-by-step tutorials to help users
get started quickly.

### Does Remaker AI support multilingual content generation?

+

Yes. Remaker AI supports content generation in multiple languages including English, Chinese,
Japanese, German, and many others, allowing users worldwide to create high-quality assets in their
preferred language.

### How much does Remaker AI cost?

+

Remaker AI offers flexible credit-based plans ranging from $5.99 for 200 credits to $299 for 20,000
credits. Users can choose the package that best fits their needs. Many basic features are also
available for free.

### Does Remaker AI offer free credits or a free trial?

+

Yes. New users receive free credits upon sign-up, which can be used to generate and export
watermark-free images and videos. Additional credits and advanced features can be unlocked by
upgrading to VIP.

### Can I cancel my Remaker AI subscription at any time?

+

Remaker AI uses a one-time credit purchase model with no recurring monthly fees, so there is no
subscription to cancel.

### Can I use Remaker AI on both PC and mobile devices?

+

Yes. Remaker AI works seamlessly on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. Log in with the same
account and edit or enhance your photos and videos anytime, anywhere.

### Is payment on Remaker AI secure?

+

Yes. All payments are securely processed by Stripe. Remaker AI does not store your card information.
Stripe uses bank-level encryption and security standards to keep your payment information safe.

TheNNT Rating System
**The Green Rating**
Therapies rated green are the best you can get
**The Yellow Rating**
Therapies rated yellow require more studies OR therapies with equal efficacy.
**The Red Rating**
Red suggest that benefits and harms may be equal or equivocal.
**The Black Rating**
Therapies rated black have very clear harms without any benefit.

## Highlighted Reviews

05/14/2026

### [Alpha-Lipoic Acid for Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy][43]

Alpha-lipoic acid shows little to no benefit over placebo for improving symptoms or impairment
[Read More][44]
04/30/2026

### [Testosterone Replacement in Men With Sexual Dysfunction in the Absence of Hypogonadism][45]

Testosterone replacement therapy shows no clear benefit over placebo
[Read More][46]
04/23/2026

### [Sustained-Release Naltrexone for Opioid Dependence][47]

Sustained-release naltrexone reduces illicit opioid use compared to standard care but shows slightly
worse outcomes than opioid agonists
[Read More][48]

## Recent Reviews

04/09/2026

### [Gonadotropins for Infertility in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome][49]

Gonadotropins increased live birth and clinical pregnancy rates
[Read More][50]
04/07/2026

### [Surgical vs. Nonsurgical Treatments for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome][51]

Surgery resulted in higher clinical improvement at long-term follow-up compared with splinting alone
[Read More][52]
03/31/2026

### [Higher Versus Lower Mean Arterial Blood Pressure Targets in Vasodilatory Shock][53]

Higher MAP targets are likely associated with increased 28-day all-cause mortality, less RRT-free
days, and increased risk of arrhythmia
[Read More][54]
02/17/2026

### [Extracorporeal Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation for Refractory Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest][55]

Extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation did not improve favorable neurological status at the
shortest follow-up and at 6 months or reduce in-hospital mortality when compared to conventional
ACLS
[Read More][56]
02/12/2026

### [Intravenous Thrombolysis for Minor Acute Ischemic Stroke][57]

Intravenous thrombolysis lowered functional independence and increased deaths at 90 days
[Read More][58]
01/29/2026

### [Noninvasive Respiratory Support for Pediatric Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure][59]

Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) reduced risk of invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV)
compared to standard oxygen therapy (SOT), while both CPAP and high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC)
reduced treatment failure compared to SOT
[Read More][60]

## Your health, on your time

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.
* Manage your appointments
* View your test results
* Send messages to your doctor
* Request medication refills
* Pay your bill

* 2k Health Care Providers
* 26 Emergency & Urgent Care Locations
* 5 Dental
  Locations

## Inside the Engine

URLert is an orchestrated system of specialized AI agents.

### Domain Intelligence

Before scanning content, we analyze the domain. We check for **Typosquatting** (e.g., `paypa1.com`),
domain age, and high-risk TLDs to catch attacks before they even load.

Typosquat Detection Newly Registered Domain

### The Orchestrator

Our "Fail-Fast" engine. If the domain is obviously malicious, we stop there. If it's suspicious, we
trigger deeper scans. It intelligently routes the URL to optimize speed and cost.

Context-Aware Smart Routing

### Static & Cloaking Analysis

We simulate multiple visitors (Mobile Device, Desktop, GoogleBot) simultaneously. This forces
"Cloaking" attacks to reveal their true payloads targeting mobile victims.

Anti-Cloaking User-Agent Variance

### Visual & Behavioral

For high-stakes URLs, we launch a headless browser. We use **Computer Vision** to "see" the page
like a human, detecting fake login forms and drive-by downloads that code analysis misses.

Brand Logo Match Fake Login Detection

### The AI SOC Analyst

Finally, our LLM Synthesizer reviews all findings. It acts as a Senior Security Analyst, ignoring
noise and writing a human-readable explanation of *why* the site is dangerous.

## Common Questions About Link Safety

Everything you need to know about checking suspicious URLs and staying safe online.

How do I check if a link from a text or email is a scam?
Simply copy the link and paste it into the search bar above. **Do not click the link first.** URLert
uses an AI-powered investigation engine to "visit" the site for you in a secure environment. We
analyze the page layout, check for hidden redirects, and look for signs of brand impersonation (like
a fake bank login) so you don't have to risk your own device.
Why is URLert better than Google or VirusTotal for new links?
Traditional scanners rely on "blacklists"—which means they only catch a scam *after* people have
already been hurt. **URLert is built for zero-day threats.** Our AI acts like a human analyst: it
takes a real-time screenshot and reads the code of the site the second you scan it. This allows us
to detect brand-new scams and phishing pages hours or even days before the big databases catch up.
What does "Zero-Day Phishing" mean?
A "zero-day" attack is a brand-new scam created today that no one has seen yet. Scammers often
register new domains (like `yourbank-secure-login.top`) and send out thousands of texts before
Google or Microsoft can flag them. URLert's AI looks at the domain age, registration details (RDAP),
and visual cues to identify these "infant" threats instantly.
Can I safely scan shortened links (like bit.ly or t.co)?
Yes. Shortened links are the #1 way scammers hide their tracks. When you paste a shortened URL into
URLert, our engine follows the "breadcrumb trail" through every redirect until it finds the final
destination. We scan that final page to ensure it's not a cloaked attack designed to steal your
credentials.
How does the URLert Guard Chrome Extension protect me?
URLert Guard is like having a security expert sitting next to you. It uses the same AI engine to
monitor the sites you visit. If you land on a page our engine has flagged as dangerous, a warning
appears in the corner of your screen — no interruption, just an immediate heads-up so you can leave
before engaging with the site. You can also use it to scan any page on the fly to understand exactly
why it might be suspicious.

Google or Microsoft can flag them. URLert's AI looks at the domain age, registration details (RDAP),
and visual cues to identify these "infant" threats instantly.

### [][46]
### The Beh Center

### [][47]
### For Vestibular & Migraine Disorders

We are a one-of-a-kind clinical center that specializes in caring for people with balance disorders,
vertigo, dizziness, nystagmus, and migraine.  Many conditions can affect balance, and cause vertigo
and dizziness. We help our patients diagnose the causes accurately, then work closely with them to
design a personalized, holistic treatment plan to help restore their balance, and get their lives
back. Similarly, migraine can manifest with a huge variety of symptoms, not just a headache. We help
our patients treat their migraine comprehensively, to restore their quality of life.

### [][48]
### CONDITIONS WE TREAT

### [][49]
### BALANCE DISORDERS

We specialize in the diagnosis and treatment of disorders that affect the balance system, including:
* Vertigo
* Dizziness
* Imbalance/Disequilibrium/Loss of Balance
* Nystagmus/Oscillopsia
* Vestibular Disorders
* Cerebellar Disorders
* Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV)
* Vestibular neuritis
* Vestibular weakness/hypofunction
* Visual vertigo/dizziness
* Visual disturbances that affect balance
* Vestibular symptoms from COVID-19


We provide [comprehensive care][50] for people with:
* Vestibular Migraine
* Persistent Postural Perceptual Dizziness (PPPD)
* Mal de Debarquement Syndrome (MDDS)


Please click [here][51] for more information.

### [][52]
### MIGRAINE

Our Center also specializes in the comprehensive treatment of people with migraine. Migraine is much
more than a headache. It is often accompanied by many, many other symptoms. We have a focus and
interest on the relationship between migraine and vertigo, dizziness, motion sensitivity, balance
problems, and motion sickness.

Please click [here][53] for more information.
